column1: # r-zig binary repository: the curated packages (repo/README.md).
# build-repo.R builds each row and its hard dependencies (Depends,
# Imports, LinkingTo, from CRAN) into binaries; install-test.R installs
# the rows from the finished repository into an R without compilers and
#   env       NAME=VALUE;NAME=VALUE for this package's build, or '-'
#   smoke     one R expression, TRUE when the package works; no network
# A row whose package links a library outside R's own environment needs
# that library's -devel package in the build env (repo.yaml's specs); the
# builder copies the run-time library into the binary (PACKAGES'
# RZig-Bundled names it), so the consumer needs nothing more. Prefer a
# package's bundled static copy where it has one (fs's libuv): smaller.
